Summary: Creation is God's free act of making all things out of nothing by His word, declaring them good, and sustaining them by His power. It reveals His glory, wisdom, and kindness, and gives human beings, made in His image, both dignity and purpose. Caring for creation and marveling at it are fitting responses to a Creator who still upholds every star and sparrow.
KeyPassages: Genesis 1:1; Genesis 1:27; Psalm 19:1; John 1:3; Colossians 1:16-17; Hebrews 11:3; Revelation 4:11
RelatedQuestions: Did God create the world in six literal days?; What does it mean to be made in the image of God?
